name: Ingevec S.A.
summary: Ingevec S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the engineering and construction business in Chile. The company operates through Engineering and Construction; Real Estate; and Investment and Income segments. It is involved in the study, promotion, administration, and execution of real estate projects and developments, which includes homes, buildings, civil, and other related works, as well as offers architecture and engineering services; and provision of professional and consultancy services. The company also invests in hotel and office projects located in Chile and Peru. Ingevec S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
